newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end higher on Dow rise, poll hopes.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end higher on Dow rise, poll hopes.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed higher on Friday, propped up psychologically by a new record high on Wall Street overnight as well as hopes that Japan's general election on Sunday will produce a stable government capable of executing policies to help the economy, brokers said.
The benchmark Nikkei 225 ended 188.56 points or 0.88 percent higher at 21,612.30. Its December futures gained 200 to end at 21,700.
"Institutional investors were buying in anticipation of the elections," said Daiichi Securities analyst Akishige Ishikura. "Futures-linked trade also made the market hum with activity."
